detail.longDescription:
Attached: 4 images

Another project where I didn't write a single line of code:

A Home Assistant monitor for Google Antigravity quotas. Tracks rolling 5h & weekly limits for Gemini and Claude/GPT, burn rate, and reset countdowns so you don't get cut off mid-vibe.

Dashboard cards look pretty damn good on mobile too.

https://github.com/brunopatuleia/ha_gemini_usage
